title: S10: Stale reset events apply unconditionally

description: A peer offline for months applies a January 'Reset Everywhere' event the moment it reconnects in July, destroying six months of offline work - requestedAt is never read, and there is no expiry or user confirmation. Separately, a local-only peer that receives the event retries it FOREVER (apply throws on wrong mode) and never acknowledges receipt. PRODUCT DECISION (Mikey, 2026-07-28): remote reset events are NEVER auto-applied - the receiving device always prompts the user before applying. An expiry window as a hygiene bound is still worth keeping; its exact duration is a council-vote decision for this plan. Severity: High. Wave/Plan: Wave 3, plan 3b reset-propagation-safety. Sweep: sync machinery.
